title: Render Mock-only DAILY priority stack shell
prohibited_actions: No HTTP request, ObserverOS API, database, credential, media, or deployment access
No task, reminder, alert, queue, appointment, person, customer, room, work-order, financial, or raw-source fixture
No business calculation, priority calculation, automatic patrol, schedule, AI result, permission decision, or authoritative state
No camera rendering, browser media access, RTSP/NVR access, website-workflow implementation, or summary-value implementation
acceptance: DAILY preserves frozen order: anchored task marquee followed by the dynamic module stack
The stack exposes only frozen module identities and each one visibly states that a verified ObserverOS source, reason, and order are required
The UI applies no local reordering; it records that a future approved OS response is the only ordering authority
Every absence remains explicitly EMPTY and Mock-only, without zero-fill or inferred work
Verification proves no network primitive, business fixture, local priority logic, or forbidden field
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
